body:
Added /admin/game-claim-codes, a simple form mirroring the GFD admin tool style, so a Premium/test claim code can be minted from the Back Office UI instead of shelling in to run cmd/gen-claim-codes. Same INSERT/code-format as the CLI (claimCodeRe-matching), verified via a real in-memory-sqlite-migrated smoke test (generate -> list -> format check) before deploy. Also lists the last 50 codes per game with used/unused status. Deployed to production (iduna.service restarted, confirmed active, route returns the same 401-gated response as every other admin tool when unauthenticated). Commit 7a961dd.

⚓ ☃
title: Game Claim Codes back office tool (S508)
